title: List of chapters in Shiji
text:
The Shiji, written by the Han dynasty historian Sima Qian, is about 526,000 Chinese characters long, making it four times longer than Thucydides' History of the Peloponnesian War, and longer than the Hebrew Bible.
Sima Qian organized the chapters of the Shiji into five categories, each comprising a section of the book: Annals, Tables, Treatises, Hereditary Houses, and Ranked Biographies.
